title: Archive year depth
prompt: Using a recursive CTE, list archive years from the earliest publication year up to five years later.

hint: Anchor on MIN(pub_date) year and recurse five steps.
sample_sql:
-- PostgreSQL target dialect
WITH RECURSIVE years(archive_year, end_year) AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM MIN(pub_date))::int, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM MIN(pub_date))::int + 5 FROM times_archive UNION ALL SELECT archive_year + 1, end_year FROM years WHERE archive_year < end_year) SELECT archive_year FROM years;

reference_sql: WITH RECURSIVE years(archive_year, end_year) AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM MIN(pub_date))::int, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM MIN(pub_date))::int + 5 FROM times_archive UNION ALL SELECT archive_year + 1, end_year FROM years WHERE archive_year < end_year) SELECT archive_year FROM years ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 500;
